dailyActionBudget: The UI has no fixed actions-per-day counter. Engine actions spend their configured stamina and/or game minutes; movement costs 5 minutes per tile, gather spends 10 stamina and 15–43 minutes by skill, farming spends 4–6 stamina and 10–20 minutes, craft spends recipe-defined stamina/time (starterSpear: 10/45 minutes), encounter starts spend 8 stamina, combat turns advance 1 minute and retreat advances 10 minutes, and village rest restores 35 stamina/15 HP in 60 minutes (inn: full recovery, 8 gold, 480 minutes). The runner uses midnight only as a time-series boundary, chooses legal actions repeatedly within the day, and simulates the remainder when the policy has no legal useful action. The 80-decision daily ceiling is a harness safety guard, not a game/UI rule; actions can cross midnight.

routePolicies.life: Only legal public gather/farm/craft/sell/rest/travel actions; never starts a voluntary encounter. Plants all-season wheat when a plot is free, harvests when mature, reserves 3 wood and 2 stone for starterSpear at the store station, follows planCraft readiness, and sells gathered surplus only after the reserve is protected.
routePolicies.adventure: Uses legal public movement, contentEncounterOptions/encounterContentMonster, wolfEncounterOptions/encounterWolf, forest encounter, and the explicit Goblin Chief challenge only while bossAlive. Rotates forest/mine/valley by game day, picks the highest eligible rank, equips legal upgrades, and uses combat/rest thresholds; caps normal-rank starts at three per day but continues for any eligible higher rank as a policy rule.
routePolicies.hybrid: Alternates the full Life policy and Adventure policy by in-game day; if combat is active, resolves it before taking an action from either half. Both halves must complete successful actions per seed.
